items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: Jimmy Johnson, yes. Mr. Johnson. I always called him Mr. Johnson. As a bass player.

ctx.x: Are there any other bass players you remember? Do you remember Jimmy Johnson when you were here?

Jimmy Johnson, yes. Mr. Johnson. I always called him Mr. Johnson. As a bass player. Yes, he was another one. He played up now mostly. Yeah. He was a fine bass player too. Yes, he did. All those men used to read very good. They were good readers. Like old man Kimball and Jimmy. And this fellow, I'm telling you, was my brother then. And then Simon, later on when I got with Simon, he was the first one who started me to read him. Showed me how to bow bass. And I'll never forget. And he was always right. He says, Al,…
Like you do last time. He says, bow.
